Splash.heading: An experienced childcare professional for weddings, events and more…

What.heading: What I Do
What.para: I am an experienced childcare professional offering a friendly, nurturing and high-quality pop-up crèche for the little guests at your event. My focus is to give the children at your wedding, or event, a fun and special experience, allowing the adults to fully relax and enjoy being present in the moment. I understand children, and their care is at the centre of everything I do. Let me help you ensure that they and you have a wonderful time on your special day! I understand that every wedding or event is unique. I offer a free consultation where I take the time to listen to your needs and then create a bespoke service just for you.

Content.cnc: This is a one to one service where I will attend the wedding dedicated to your little one. I am there to care for, play with and meet their needs as well as enabling your child to participate in attending photoshoots and facilitating special jobs such as being a ring bearer. I will blend in like a guest and allow for those special family moments whilst constantly being there to support, care and ensure your child’s safety, especially important if there happens to be a pool. I will personally liaise with you and/or your wedding planner to ensure smooth running of your special day.
Content.pnc:
Travelling with young children is exciting and such an important part of creating family bonds, memories and adventures. But we all know that family holidays and special events can also be busy and tiring, and sometimes everyone needs a little time to rest and recharge.

My childcare service is designed to support families during holidays, events and special occasions, providing individual or small-group childcare for up to 5 children, with ratios adapted according to the children's ages and needs. Please note that the minimum booking is for 2 days and the maximum is for 7 days.

I can provide childcare close to where your holiday or event is taking place, or accompany your family throughout your trip. This gives children the opportunity to enjoy a fun-filled day at their own pace, while parents and other adults have some valuable time to relax, reconnect or simply enjoy some restorative time together.

I bring a selection of age-appropriate toys, books, games and activities, along with a wealth of knowledge and experience, so that the children in my care are engaged, happy and well looked after.

Every family is different, so I take the time to understand your individual needs and create a bespoke childcare package that works for you. Whether you need childcare for part of your holiday, support during a special event, or someone to accompany your family for the duration of your trip, we can create an arrangement that suits your plans.
Content.wcc: This is the option I provide for groups of between 2 and 5 children. Please note I do not provide childcare for large groups; I do this to ensure quality of care is consistent. The crèche is a fun-filled day in which I set up a playspace filled with beautiful and enchanting games and activities to delight the little ones of those attending your wedding. The crèche must take place in a self-contained room, with easy bathroom access, that is for sole use of the crèche throughout the agreed hours. A sign-in/ sign-out system allows children to be brought to and from the crèche to fit with your plan for the day, such as to be part of the wedding party or to attend a meal. It is a great space for children to have their needs met during a typically adult event, allowing the adults to relax and fully enjoy your special day. It is popular to have meals brought to the crèche so children can eat with me.

Meet.heading: Meet Me
Meet.sinead: I am a qualified childcare professional with 20 years of experience in a variety of settings including as a childminder and foster carer. I bring a wealth of experience including a depth of knowledge in additional needs support and children’s development. I love what I do and children never cease to amaze me. I am passionate about supporting families. At the pop-up crèche I love spending time with children, having fun and facilitating an easy and relaxing family experience. I bring a fun, engaging presence that quickly puts children at ease.
Meet.harriet: Harriet is a teacher and qualified children’s counsellor accredited with the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy. She has years of experience working with children, from little ones through to teenagers, in a broad variety of settings. She loves joining children in imaginative play and facilitating creative activities. She is always there to encourage and help children feel able to join in. She is empathic and warm and enjoys offering a calm, supportive space for children to play.
Meet.gaelle: Gaelle started her career as a dance teacher. She spent 10 years teaching children age 3 and upwards, and later created her own dance association. She also has 14 years of experience as an activity leader and director in schools, summer camps, and adventure holidays, where groups of children are taken for weeks of adventure throughout France and abroad. She is funny, kind and full of ideas. She is a wonderful mother of 3 little girls. Gaelle is French with an intermediate level of English.
Meet.rachel: Rachel is a qualified and registered nurse with 15 years of experience, she is confident in dealing with any ouchies that occur in the day to day life of little ones. If your child has any medical conditions that you would like to discuss with Rachel, or you would like to specifically request her as your nanny, do get in touch to discuss. Rachel is absolutely brilliant with children; as a mum of three boys she is used to fun and adventure and she knows all the best games!

list.one: 'Sinead and the Pop Up Wedding Crèche are incredible and easily one of the best decisions we made regarding our wedding in July 2025. Our little girl was 11 months old at the time and she had a great wedding experience thanks to Sinead - she was a very happy baby over the 3 days as she had excellent care and attention!'
list.two: 'Sinead was absolutely fabulous when she provided the 1-2-1 nanny service for the full weekend for our wedding. We have a very adventurous 1 year old and Sinead could not have been better, he was very happy all weekend and loved spending time with her. It meant that we felt totally present and not worried at all and could enjoy our day and have some reprieve during the night. Sinead’s experience was evident in that she was so patient and behind the scenes got him into his wedding outfit at the right time and without us knowing had spent time for him to get to know the venue for the ceremony which meant he was happy enough to walk down the aisle! Thank you so much Sinead. We highly recommend! X'

qs.a1: A wedding is a special day to celebrate your love with those you love. It’s a time to let your hair down, relax and enjoy yourself after all the hard work that has gone into the planning. Some parts of the day, although beautiful, can feel tiring for little ones - that’s where I come in. I arrive and create a beautiful, peaceful and fun environment for children of all ages to enjoy. Every element is thought about, from activities, toys and games, to a cosy place for story times and naps, let your guests take a breath knowing I’ve got it all covered to make their day easier. You can relax knowing that when it comes to your little guests, I have it all in hand.
qs.a2: I can offer high quality childcare, backed by 20 years of experience. I can offer childcare for up to five children and I ensure that I get to know all the families who I work with in advance, I do this through information forms, video calls and text messages. I can either accompany individual children to an event or I can create a small and enriching play area for them to use. I am passionate about supporting families and making space for children to play. This can be during a wedding, event, holiday or any other reason you may need childcare whilst travelling.
qs.a3: Please contact me either through the site or at the email address thepopupweddingcreche@gmail.com. Two or three day packages are my most popular bookings, and a deposit of 50% is required to reserve your date. Do contact me for a free, no obligation video call where we can discuss your individual childcare needs.
qs.q4: What else do I need to know?
qs.a4: I am safeguarding and first aid trained, fully insured and criminal record checked. In planning for your event, I will take information from you such as allergies and additional needs to ensure that I take the best care of each child. The pop-up crèche is full of beautiful toys, specially chosen to enchant your little ones. I will take information from you about the age and interests of your little guests, and you can leave the rest to me; everything I do will be tailored to them.
